== Report ==
Nice and very close games. Russia B had to play with a slight ping disadvantage. The score in The Abandoned Base was very close from the beginning, SS clearing red armor area nicely, however [[xpr]]'s solid Quad-runs decided the end of the game.

In e1m2 Russia B had worse start, they had to get on their feet which they pretty much managed to and they made the scores close again. In the deciding fights for the yellow armor Russia A was more lucky surviving those and won this game.
